conclusion_reason: The shop as controller must keep the data accurate and up to date under section 35, and if it does not act on the request it must record the request with reasons in the section 39 record under section 36, with the customer able to complain to the expert committee via section 34 paragraph 2, as the answer states.

problems.why: Section 37(2) only requires the controller to prevent a recipient from using or disclosing data without authority or unlawfully; it does not impose a duty to propagate corrections to recipients or processors.
